fact: The DGID says SENTAX now replaces ETAX for online filing of returns by Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers.
The DGID says SENTAX lets Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers pay taxes online (telepaiement).

The DGID says use of SENTAX becomes mandatory for all declarations and payments of Large Enterprises Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026, and paper returns are no longer accepted by that directorate.
The DGID says SENTAX is its online platform for tax filing (télédéclaration), replacing ETAX for large-enterprise taxpayers.
The DGID says SENTAX handles online payment (télépaiement) of taxes and levies.

The DGID says use of SENTAX is mandatory and paper returns are no longer accepted for Large Enterprise Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026, and for the Dakar medium-enterprise centres and regulated professions centre from 1 October 2026.
The DGID says that from September 2023 all filing obligations of Centre des professions réglementées users are made by tele-declaration on the Etax platform.
The DGID says that from September 2023 all payment obligations of Centre des professions réglementées users are made by tele-payment on Etax.
The DGID says Etax filing and payment become mandatory for Centre des professions réglementées users from September 2023, under ministerial decision no. 02 of 2 August 2023.
